changes.title: Refuse an older store with a clear message
changes.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Detect a v0.1 or v0.2 store and any schema newer than supported. Stop with a clear message naming the supported client 0.3 and server 0.3 pair and the data root. Leave the older store untouched.

**Verify** · Point v0.3 at a copied v0.1 and v0.2 store and observe the refusal. Start a fresh v0.3 store afterwards. Confirm the older files and hashes are unchanged.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-056

**Queue** · Follows WI-057 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
